question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

After seventeen surgeries, a life-threatening infection, a lost season and months of arduos rehab, Smith returned to the field in October.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"arduos"** is incorrectly spelt. It should be **"arduous"**, which means something that is very difficult and requires a lot of effort. (कठिन)

 
 
• **Example: **The** arduous **journey through the mountains tested their endurance.
 
 
 
• **"Arduous"** refers to tasks or activities **that demand considerable effort and hard work.** (कठिन)
 
 
• **Example: **Climbing the steep cliff was an **arduous** task.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Surgeries** (सर्जरी): Medical procedures involving an incision with instruments.

 
 
• **Example:** She underwent multiple surgeries to correct her condition.
 
 
 
• **Threatening** (धमकी भरा): Having a hostile or frightening quality.
 
 
• **Example: **The threatening clouds signaled an incoming storm.
 
 
 
• **Season** (मौसम): A specific period of the year characterized by particular conditions of weather, temperature, etc.
 
 
• **Example:** Winter is my favorite season because I love snow.
